approval_source.question_set: The seven simulation runs and the statistical campaign: pass thresholds, timings, host access, load source

reason: The seven runs had requirements but no plan: no pass criteria, no way to drive the console-only hosts, no load source, and approved timings longer than a 24-hour run.

decisions.question: D14-Q02
decisions.rule: Integrity, in every run: zero conflicting finalized blocks; the same app hash on every node at every checkpoint; supply that reconciles exactly (DRT genesis plus emitted minus burned, DGT unchanged); no committed block lost in any recovery. An integrity failure stops the run. Liveness, outside injected faults: median block interval at most 6 s and 99th percentile at most 10 s. Inclusion: at half capacity, 99% of valid transactions committed within 2 blocks; at full capacity, no valid transaction lost (each is committed or refused at admission). Recovery, within the approved targets: blocks again within 5 minutes of a validator process restart, sentry and endpoint caught up within 2 minutes of a network heal, a destroyed sentry or endpoint rebuilt within 4 hours, a lost validator host within 8 hours, and every injected fault raising its alert and resolving after recovery. Load (R06): full capacity, about 180 basic Sends a block, held for 1 hour and half capacity for 6 hours, across 1,000 wallets. A missed threshold fails the run, and the affected runs are rerun on the next candidate.

decisions.question: D14-Q02
decisions.rule: The launch is task-driven, not date-driven: each step starts when the steps it depends on are done, and no calendar dates are set. The only time chosen in advance is the genesis time, set at the final input freeze by the approved rule (a weekday at 14:00:00 UTC, at least 72 hours after the final build).

decisions.question: D14-Q02
decisions.selected: Short in R01-R06, exact in R07
decisions.rule: R01 to R06 run with a recorded set of shortened timings, so each lifecycle (upgrade and handover notice, governance deposit and voting periods and timelock, unbonding maturity, snapshot interval) completes inside its 24-hour run. Every other value is the production value, and each shortened value is listed with its production value in the run record. R07, the dress rehearsal, uses the exact production values.

decisions.question: D12-Q01, D14-Q02
decisions.rule: While the production hosts serve as staging, each runs a small agent that pulls command files from the backup bucket over the host's curl, runs a command only if the founder's ML-DSA-65 staging command key signed it and it is on a fixed allowlist of simulation steps, and uploads the results encrypted. TLS stays transport only. The agent is never part of a release, and the wipe before the production install removes it; production hosts stay console-only.

decisions.question: D14-Q02
decisions.rule: The load for R03 and R06 comes from four to eight small rented machines, each with its own address, outside the hosts' providers, so the endpoint's production connection limits stay unchanged and the public client channel path is the one tested. They are rented for the load runs only and hold only rehearsal keys.

decisions.question: D14-Q02
decisions.rule: During staging, before the freeze, the production hosts run a statistical campaign with rehearsal identities: every listed attack type on the core functions attempted at least 3,000 times with zero successes (by the rule of three, a success rate below 1 in 1,000 at 95% confidence); each connection- or network-level attack and each quick fault repeated about 30 times, and each heavy fault (host rebuild, snapshot restore, validator recovery) 3 to 5 times, with recovery times recorded; and an endurance run of at least 15 days at the exact production values, inside which the attack and fault campaigns interleave, covering the full unbonding, governance and upgrade notice lifecycles and at least 15 epochs. Any successful attack is a defect fixed before the freeze. The campaign's report goes to Hashlock with the frozen candidate. The seven pass/fail runs stay as they are.

unset: The exact shortened timing values, fixed when the rehearsal genesis is built
The staging command key and the agent's allowlist, built and proven in CI
The campaign's attack list and counts per type, fixed when the tools are built
does_not_authorize: any run on a real host
